# ADR-0016: Candidate build modes — how a proposal becomes a measured artifact

> **Status:** proposed | **Date:** 2026-07-09

**References:** [ADR-0001](../adr/ADR-0001.md), [ADR-0005](../adr/ADR-0005.md), [ADR-0008](../adr/ADR-0008.md), [ADR-0009](../adr/ADR-0009.md), [ADR-0014](../adr/ADR-0014.md), [ADR-0015](../adr/ADR-0015.md), [RFC-0001](../rfc/RFC-0001.md)

## Context

The step between "agent edited a file" and "judge read a score" is undocumented. Three modes exist in practice: no artifact (compile and run in place), no rebuild (config tuning only), and build and roll (derive-layer for Python, full image build for compiled). Two critical properties are unenforceable without naming the modes: compile errors should be free (not spend a candidate), and unchanged components should not rebuild.

## Decision

Name the modes, declare per component, engine enforces preconditions. mode is a typed per-component manifest field (none/derive-layer/image). crucible check enforces preconditions (same-registry for derive-layer, no compiled sources in derive-layer paths, frozen Containerfile for image mode). The build recipe is part of the judge (Containerfile must be a frozen inject). Modes live in the contract, not only the ADR. Per-iteration builds stay on-cluster (dispatch latency rules out GH Actions for per-turn builds).

## Consequences

Positive: mode becomes readable, checkable, and reviewable in the manifest. Silent 20-minute or no-op failure modes become crucible check errors. The reward-hacking hole in the build recipe closes (Containerfile must be a frozen inject). [ADR-0015](../adr/ADR-0015.md)'s P5 gains its precondition.

Negative: mode is a new per-component field every domain must declare. crucible check's precondition enforcement adds validation complexity. The closed set of modes (none/derive-layer/image) may not cover future build strategies.

## Alternatives Considered

### Name the modes as a typed per-component manifest field (none/derive-layer/image), engine enforces preconditions via crucible check, build recipe is part of the frozen judge (accepted)


### Leave build mode as implicit bash in apply hooks with no engine enforcement (rejected)
